NOTE: Municipalities are authorized to adopt any of the following state minimum standard codes or to adopt any Lawful ordinance, regulation or resolution which is more restrictive than the provisions of the state minimum standard codes. Se Ga. Code Ann. 84-6014, 84-6015.

If a municipality adopted a standard code prior to July 1, 1969, pursuant to charter amendment, local law or any general statue, it is authorized to continue operating under such code, | uniess and until it chooses by: affirmative act to adopt the state code. See Ga. Code Ann. 84-6013.

Any amendments to any state code which are approved by a majority of the members of the State Building Administrative Board are automatically incorporated into such code with like effect as if they were included in the original adopted code. See Ga. Code Ann. 84-6012.

Finally, municipalities adopting any state minimum standard codes are authorized to adopt by ordinance or resolution any reasonable provisions for the enforcement of such codes, may employ inspectors and other personnel necessary for proper enforcement, and may contract with other municipalities or county inspectors. See Ga. Code Ann. . 84-6016.

Definitions of terms used in Code.

Penalties. Any person who: shall violate any of the provisions of the Georgia State Housing Code or fail to comply therewith, or who shall violate or fail to comply with any order made thereunder shall for each such failure or violation or noncompliance, be punished by a fine not to exceed $300 and costs, or by imprisonment not to exceed one month, or both, any and.all such penalties to be imposed in the discretion of the Judge of the Recorder's Court.
